_harder: What a level does to every fight (#291): `intensity` scales the attacks, `damage` adds to each hit, `mercy` and `join` scale the odds a monster takes mercy and how much it wants to come along. A level without it is a fight as it was. `effect` is what the log says the level does, when the halls turn.

levels.effect: Every fight comes at you harder now, and few will take mercy or follow you.
levels.down: The last torch goes out behind its own flame. Nothing down here has a face any more.

levels.effect: Fights come harder: they hit harder, and mercy and friends come slower.
levels.up: One torch opens an eye, and shuts it again when you look.
levels.down: The torches have shut their eyes as you go by.

levels.effect: They come at you a little faster, and mercy is a little harder to find.
levels.up: The torches look at you again, sidelong.
levels.down: The torches look away from you.

levels.effect: The halls let you be: fights are as they were.
levels.up: The torches turn back to you.
levels.down: The torches stop leaning your way.

levels.up: The torches lean in as you pass. They seem glad.
